audioRequiredUz: 14-mashqda o'nta bashoratni AYOL (W) yoki ERKAK (M) aytganini belgilash kerak. Bu ma'lumot FAQAT AUDIODA bor — kitobda hech qanday ip yo'q. Shuning uchun W/M taqsimoti TO'LDIRILMADI; o'rniga har bir gapning to'liq tarjimasi va grammatikasi berilgan. 15-mashqda esa dialoglar BOSILGAN — kim taklifni qabul qilgani va kim rad etgani matndan ANIQ ko'rinadi, audio kerak emas. 16-mashq (talaffuz) audio bilan tekshiriladi, lekin har bir so'zning javobi qoida bo'yicha aniq.
scanNote: Writing qutisi xatni 'FOUR paragraphs' ga bo'lish kerak deydi, lekin quyidagi 'Plan' BESH xatboshini ko'rsatadi (Para 1, 2, 3, 4, 5). Bu kitobning kichik nomuvofiqligi. Amalda Plan'ga amal qilish kerak: kirish (1) + asosiy qism (2, 3, 4) + xulosa (5).

exercises.instructionEn: What will life be like in 30 years' time? Read the sentences, then listen and put a W for the woman's predictions and an M for the man's.
exercises.instructionUz: 30 yildan keyin hayot qanday bo'ladi? Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va ayolning bashoratlariga W, erkakning bashoratlariga M qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ HALOL OGOHLANTIRISh:
  Qaysi bashoratni AYOL (W), qaysinisini ERKAK (M)
  aytgani FAQAT AUDIODA bor.
  Kitobda hech qanday ip yo'q — na strelka,
  na namuna.
  Shuning uchun W/M taqsimoti TO'LDIRILMADI.
  Taxmin qilib yozish noto'g'ri bo'lardi.

  Quyida har bir gapning TO'LIQ tarjimasi va
  GRAMMATIKASI berilgan — bu mashqning asosiy
  o'quv qiymati.


SAVOL: 'What will life be LIKE in 30 years'
time?'
  = 30 yildan keyin hayot QANDAY bo'ladi?

  DIQQAT: 'What ... LIKE?' — TASVIRLASh so'raydi
  (Unit 12, Coursebook 85-betdan).
  'in 30 years' TIME' = 30 yildan keyin.
  Apostrof 'years'' — ko'plikdan keyin.


O'N BAShORAT VA TARJIMASI:

   1  People will travel in flying cars.
      (Odamlar uchar mashinalarda sayohat qiladi.)

   2  People will live in underwater cities.
      (Odamlar suv ostidagi shaharlarda yashaydi.)

   3  Life will be more expensive.
      (Hayot qimmatroq bo'ladi.)

   4  People will go on holiday to the moon.
      (Odamlar Oyga ta'tilga boradi.)

   5  There will be more people in the world.
      (Dunyoda odamlar ko'proq bo'ladi.)

   6  Pollution will be worse.
      (Ifloslanish yomonroq bo'ladi.)

   7  There won't be enough trees.
      (Yetarlicha daraxt bo'lmaydi.)

   8  People will use oxygen masks to breathe.
      (Odamlar nafas olish uchun kislorod
       niqoblaridan foydalanadi.)

   9  There will be food pills instead of fresh
      food.
      (Yangi ovqat o'rniga ovqat tabletkalari
       bo'ladi.)

  10  There won't be enough water for everyone.
      (Hamma uchun yetarlicha suv bo'lmaydi.)


GRAMMATIK TAHLIL — TO'RT XIL QOLIP:

  A) ega + WILL + ASOSIY fe'l
     'People WILL TRAVEL ...'
     'People WILL LIVE ...'
     'People WILL GO ...'
     'People WILL USE ...'
     (1, 2, 4, 8-bandlar)

  B) ega + WILL BE + SIFAT
     'Life WILL BE more expensive.'
     'Pollution WILL BE worse.'
     (3, 6-bandlar)

  C) THERE WILL BE + OT
     'THERE WILL BE more people ...'
     'THERE WILL BE food pills ...'
     (5, 9-bandlar)

  D) THERE WON'T BE + OT  (INKOR)
     'THERE WON'T BE enough trees.'
     'THERE WON'T BE enough water ...'
     (7, 10-bandlar)

  Bu — 95-betdagi 'It will be / There will be'
  qoidasining amaliy qo'llanishi.


QIYOSIY DARAJALAR (Unit 12):
  'MORE EXPENSIVE'  (3-band)
  'MORE people'     (5-band)
  'WORSE'           (6-band — 'bad' ning
                     noto'g'ri qiyosiy shakli)


DIQQAT — 'ENOUGH' NING O'RNI:
  'There won't be ENOUGH TREES.'
  'enough' OT dan OLDIN turadi.
  DIQQAT: sifat bilan esa KEYIN turadi:
     'It isn't warm ENOUGH.'

DIQQAT — 'INSTEAD OF':
  'food pills INSTEAD OF fresh food'
  = yangi ovqat O'RNIGA ovqat tabletkalari.
  'instead of' + OT yoki fe'l-ING.

DIQQAT — MAQSAD 'TO':
  'use oxygen masks TO BREATHE'
  = nafas olish UChUN niqoblardan foydalanish.
  95-betdagi maqsad infinitivi.


BU BAShORATLARNING IKKI GURUHI:

  IJOBIY / TEXNOLOGIK:
     flying cars, underwater cities,
     holiday to the moon, food pills

  SALBIY / EKOLOGIK:
     more expensive, more people, worse pollution,
     not enough trees, oxygen masks,
     not enough water

  Ekologik mavzu — Unit 14 ('Dos and Don'ts,
  the environment') ga tayyorgarlik.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a flying car   = uchar mashina
  underwater     = suv ostidagi
  the moon       = Oy
  pollution      = ifloslanish
  enough         = yetarli
  an oxygen mask = kislorod niqobi
  to breathe     = nafas olmoq
  a pill         = tabletka
  instead of     = ... o'rniga
  fresh food     = yangi (tetik) ovqat

sentences.en: People will travel in flying cars.
sentences.noteUz:
QOLIP A: ega + WILL + ASOSIY fe'l.
'travel IN a car' — transport ichida IN.
95-betdagi 9-mashqning 5-bandi ham shu haqda:
'people will have flying cars'.

sentences.en: People will live in underwater cities.
sentences.noteUz:
QOLIP A.
'underwater' = suv ostidagi (under + water).
95-betdagi 'Will' qutisining namunasi:
'there will be underwater cities'.

QOLIP B: ega + WILL BE + SIFAT.
'MORE EXPENSIVE' — QIYOSIY daraja (Unit 12).
'life' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot, artikl YO'Q.

sentences.en: People will go on holiday to the moon.
sentences.noteUz:
QOLIP A.
'go ON holiday' — predlog ON, artikl YO'Q.
'THE moon' — aniq artikl (yagona narsa).

sentences.en: There will be more people in the world.
sentences.noteUz:
QOLIP C: THERE WILL BE + OT.
'people' — OT → THERE (95-bet qoidasi).
'MORE people' — 'many' ning qiyosiy shakli.

QOLIP B: ega + WILL BE + SIFAT.
'WORSE' — 'bad' ning NOTO'G'RI qiyosiy shakli
(Unit 12).
'pollution' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot.

QOLIP D: THERE WON'T BE + OT (INKOR).
'won't' = 'will not'.
'ENOUGH trees' — 'enough' OT dan OLDIN.
Ekologik mavzu — Unit 14 ga tayyorgarlik.

sentences.en: People will use oxygen masks to breathe.
sentences.uz: Odamlar nafas olish uchun kislorod niqoblaridan foydalanadi.
sentences.noteUz:
QOLIP A + MAQSAD.
'TO BREATHE' — maqsad infinitivi
(nima uchun? — nafas olish uchun).
95-betdagi qoida.

sentences.en: There will be food pills instead of fresh food.
sentences.uz: Yangi ovqat o'rniga ovqat tabletkalari bo'ladi.
sentences.noteUz:
QOLIP C: THERE WILL BE + OT.
'INSTEAD OF' = ... o'rniga (OT yoki fe'l-ING
bilan).
'a pill' = tabletka.

sentences.en: There won't be enough water for everyone.
sentences.noteUz:
QOLIP D (INKOR).
'water' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot.
'everyone' — BIRLIK olmosh.
Ekologik bashorat — eng jiddiylaridan biri.

sections.title: Communication: Accepting and Refusing Invitations
sections.titleUz: Muloqot: Taklifni qabul qilish va rad etish

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the dialogues. Who accepts an invitation? Who refuses an invitation?
exercises.instructionUz: Dialoglarni tinglang. Kim taklifni qabul qiladi? Kim rad etadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI DIALOG — BOSILGAN, AUDIO KERAK EMAS.


DIALOG a):
  A: What are you doing this Saturday, Cindy?
  B: I'M GOING TO my cousin's birthday party.
     Do you want to come with me?
  A: I'D LOVE TO.

  → A TAKLIFNI QABUL QILADI (accepts)
    'I'd love to' = Juda xohlardim / Bajonidil.


DIALOG b):
  A: Are you doing anything this Saturday, Steve?
  B: I'M GOING TO visit my parents.
     Would you like to come with me?
  A: I'D LOVE TO, BUT I CAN'T.
     I'm going to the cinema with Bob.

  → A TAKLIFNI RAD ETADI (refuses)
    'I'd love to, BUT I can't' — muloyim rad etish.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  a) A: Bu shanba kuni nima qilyapsan, Sindi?
     B: Amakivachchamning tug'ilgan kuni
        ziyofatiga boryapman. Men bilan kelishni
        xohlaysanmi?
     A: Bajonidil.

  b) A: Bu shanba kuni biror ish qilyapsanmi,
        Stiv?
     B: Ota-onamnikiga boryapman. Men bilan
        kelishni xohlaysizmi?
     A: Juda xohlardim, lekin bora olmayman.
        Bob bilan kinoga boryapman.


ENG MUHIM — MULOYIM RAD ETISh QOLIPI:

  'I'd love to, BUT I can't. [SABAB]'

  Uch qism:
     1) 'I'd love to'  — XOHLAShNI bildirish
     2) 'but I can't'  — imkonsizlik
     3) sabab           — nega bora olmaydi

  Faqat 'No' deyish QO'POL hisoblanadi.
  Ingliz tilida rad etishda DOIM sabab aytiladi.


TAKLIF QILISh IBORALARI (dialoglardan):
  'DO YOU WANT TO come with me?'
     — oddiy, norasmiy
  'WOULD YOU LIKE TO come with me?'
     — MULOYIMROQ, rasmiyroq

  Ikkalasidan keyin ham 'TO + ASOSIY fe'l'.


SAVOL BERISh IBORALARI:
  'What are you doing this Saturday?'
     — ochiq savol
  'Are you doing anything this Saturday?'
     — HA/YO'Q savoli
     DIQQAT: 'ANYTHING' — so'roq gapda
     ('something' emas).


GRAMMATIKA — HAMMASI PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  'What are you DOING this Saturday?'
  'I'm GOING to my cousin's birthday party.'
  'I'm GOING TO VISIT my parents.'
  'I'm GOING to the cinema with Bob.'

  Chunki bular QAT'IY BELGILANGAN rejalar
  (93-betdagi qoida) — sana aniq ('this
  Saturday').

  DIQQAT — IKKI XIL 'GOING':
     'I'm GOING TO my cousin's party'
        → 'go to + JOY' (present continuous)
     'I'm GOING TO VISIT my parents'
        → 'be going to + FE'L' (reja)
     Shakli o'xshash, lekin tuzilishi boshqa!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to accept an invitation = taklifni qabul qilmoq
  to refuse an invitation = taklifni rad etmoq
  a cousin      = amakivachcha, xolavachcha
  I'd love to   = bajonidil, juda xohlardim
  Would you like to ...? = ... xohlaysizmi?

sentences.en: a)  A: What are you doing this Saturday, Cindy?
sentences.uz: a)  A: Bu shanba kuni nima qilyapsan, Sindi?
sentences.noteUz:
OCHIQ savol.
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — 'this Saturday' aniq sana.

sentences.en: a)  B: I'm going to my cousin's birthday party. Do you want to come with me?
sentences.uz: a)  B: Amakivachchamning tug'ilgan kuni ziyofatiga boryapman. Men bilan kelishni xohlaysanmi?
sentences.noteUz:
'go TO + JOY' — present continuous.
TAKLIF: 'Do you want TO come ...?'
(oddiy, norasmiy).

→ TAKLIF QABUL QILINDI (accepts).
'I'd love to' = 'I would love to' —
taklifni qabul qilishning eng keng tarqalgan
shakli.
DIQQAT: 'to' dan keyin fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

sentences.en: b)  A: Are you doing anything this Saturday, Steve?
sentences.uz: b)  A: Bu shanba kuni biror ish qilyapsanmi, Stiv?
sentences.noteUz:
HA/YO'Q savoli.
DIQQAT: 'ANYTHING' — so'roq gapda
('something' emas).

sentences.en: b)  B: I'm going to visit my parents. Would you like to come with me?
sentences.uz: b)  B: Ota-onamnikiga boryapman. Men bilan kelishni xohlaysizmi?
sentences.noteUz:
'be GOING TO + FE'L' — reja.
DIQQAT: a) dagi 'going TO my cousin's party'
dan FARQ QILADI (u yerda JOY, bu yerda FE'L).
TAKLIF: 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO ...?' — MULOYIMROQ.

sentences.en: b)  A: I'd love to, but I can't. I'm going to the cinema with Bob.
sentences.uz: b)  A: Juda xohlardim, lekin bora olmayman. Bob bilan kinoga boryapman.
sentences.noteUz:
→ TAKLIF RAD ETILDI (refuses).
MULOYIM RAD ETISH — UCH QISM:
  1) 'I'd love to'  (xohlashni bildirish)
  2) 'but I can't'  (imkonsizlik)
  3) sabab: 'I'm going to the cinema with Bob'
Faqat 'No' deyish QO'POL hisoblanadi.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh KO'RSATMA:
  meet Jenny            (Jenni bilan uchrashmoq)
  go to the beach       (plyajga bormoq)
  play tennis with Claire (Kler bilan tennis
                           o'ynamoq)
  go to a disco         (diskotekaga bormoq)
  watch a play          (spektakl ko'rmoq)


IKKI QOLIP — QABUL QILISh va RAD ETISh:

  QOLIP A (qabul qilish):
     A: What are you doing this Saturday, [ism]?
     B: I'm [reja]. Do you want to come with me?
     A: I'd love to.

  QOLIP B (rad etish):
     A: Are you doing anything this Saturday,
        [ism]?
     B: I'm [reja]. Would you like to come with
        me?
     A: I'd love to, but I can't. I'm [boshqa
        reja].


BESh TAYYOR DIALOG:

1) meet Jenny — QABUL QILISh
   A: What are you doing this Saturday, Tom?
   B: I'm meeting Jenny in the town centre.
      Do you want to come with me?
   A: I'd love to.

2) go to the beach — RAD ETISh
   A: Are you doing anything this Saturday, Anna?
   B: I'm going to the beach. Would you like to
      come with me?
   A: I'd love to, but I can't. I'm visiting my
      grandparents.

3) play tennis with Claire — QABUL QILISh
   A: What are you doing this Saturday, Mike?
   B: I'm playing tennis with Claire.
      Do you want to come with me?
   A: I'd love to.

4) go to a disco — RAD ETISh
   A: Are you doing anything this Saturday, Sara?
   B: I'm going to a disco. Would you like to come
      with me?
   A: I'd love to, but I can't. I'm studying for a
      test.

5) watch a play — QABUL QILISh
   A: What are you doing this Saturday, Peter?
   B: I'm watching a play at the theatre.
      Do you want to come with me?
   A: I'd love to.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI (1-dialog):
   A: Bu shanba kuni nima qilyapsan, Tom?
   B: Shahar markazida Jenni bilan uchrashyapman.
      Men bilan kelishni xohlaysanmi?
   A: Bajonidil.


DIQQAT — HAMMA REJA PRESENT CONTINUOUS DA:
  'I'm MEETING Jenny.'
  'I'm GOING to the beach.'
  'I'm PLAYING tennis with Claire.'
  'I'm GOING to a disco.'
  'I'm WATCHING a play.'

  Chunki 'this Saturday' — ANIQ vaqt →
  QAT'IY BELGILANGAN reja (93-bet qoidasi).


DIQQAT — 'A PLAY' va 'A FILM':
  'a play' = spektakl (teatrda)
  'a film' = film (kinoteatrda)
  'watch a play' / 'see a play' — ikkalasi ham
  to'g'ri.

DIQQAT — 'A DISCO':
  'go to A disco' — artikl BOR
  ('go to disco' XATO).
  Lekin 'go to school/bed/work' — artiklsiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va belgilang. Yana tinglang va takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'H' HARFI — QAChON O'QILADI, QAChON O'QILMAYDI.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

     SO'Z        /h/ O'QILADI   /h/ O'QILMAYDI
     ─────────   ─────────────  ───────────────
     hour                              ✓
     horrible          ✓
     vehicle                           ✓
     honest                            ✓
     hand              ✓
     perhaps           ✓

  O'QILADI:      horrible, hand, perhaps
  O'QILMAYDI:    hour, vehicle, honest


HAR BIRI — TALAFFUZI:

  hour      /aʊər/     'AUER'  — 'h' O'QILMAYDI
            = soat
            DIQQAT: 'AN hour' (unli bilan
            boshlangandek) — 'a hour' XATO!

  horrible  /ˈhɒrəbl/  'HO-ribl' — 'h' O'QILADI
            = dahshatli (96-betdan)

  vehicle   /ˈviːəkl/  'VII-ikl' — 'h' O'QILMAYDI
            = transport vositasi
            DIQQAT: 'h' so'zning O'RTASIDA va
            umuman o'qilmaydi.

  honest    /ˈɒnɪst/   'O-nist'  — 'h' O'QILMAYDI
            = halol
            DIQQAT: 'AN honest man' — 'a honest'
            XATO!

  hand      /hænd/     'HEND'    — 'h' O'QILADI
            = qo'l

  perhaps   /pəˈhæps/  'pa-HEPS' — 'h' O'QILADI
            = ehtimol, balki


ENG MUHIM QOIDA — ARTIKL:
  'h' O'QILMASA, so'z UNLI tovush bilan
  boshlanadi → 'AN' ishlatiladi:

     AN hour       ✓   (a hour  ✗)
     AN honest man ✓   (a honest man ✗)
     AN honour     ✓

  'h' O'QILSA → 'A':
     A hand        ✓
     A horrible week ✓
     A house       ✓

  Ya'ni artikl HARFGA emas, TOVUShGA qaraydi.


'H' O'QILMAYDIGAN ASOSIY SO'ZLAR (yodlash kerak):
  hour      (soat)
  honest    (halol)
  honour    (sharaf)
  heir      (voris)
  vehicle   (transport vositasi)
  exhausted (holdan toygan)

  Bularning soni KAM — qolgan hamma 'h' li
  so'zlarda 'h' O'QILADI.


DIQQAT — O'ZBEK O'QUVChILARI UChUN:
  O'zbek tilida 'h' doim o'qiladi, shuning uchun
  'hour' va 'honest' so'zlari qiyinlik tug'diradi.
  Ularni ALOHIDA yodlab olish kerak.

items.whyUz:
'h' O'QILMAYDI: /aʊər/ — 'AUER'.
DIQQAT — ARTIKL: 'AN hour' ✓ / 'a hour' ✗
(so'z unli tovush bilan boshlanadi).
Eng ko'p uchraydigan 'h'-siz so'z.

'h' O'QILADI: /ˈhɒrəbl/ — 'HO-ribl'.
Artikl: 'A horrible week'.
96-betdagi Sagittarius bashoratida uchragan.

'h' O'QILMAYDI: /ˈviːəkl/ — 'VII-ikl'.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'h' so'zning O'RTASIDA
va umuman eshitilmaydi.
Eng ko'p xato qilinadigan so'z.

'h' O'QILMAYDI: /ˈɒnɪst/ — 'O-nist'.
DIQQAT — ARTIKL: 'AN honest man' ✓ /
'a honest man' ✗.
Ot shakli: 'honesty' (halollik) — unda ham
'h' o'qilmaydi.

'h' O'QILADI: /hænd/ — 'HEND'.
Artikl: 'A hand'.
Unit 12 da 'handprint' (qo'l izi) so'zi uchragan.

'h' O'QILADI: /pəˈhæps/ — 'pa-HEPS'.
DIQQAT: 'h' so'zning O'RTASIDA, lekin
'vehicle' dan farqli, bu yerda O'QILADI.
Coursebook 86-betda uchragan.

sections.title: Writing — a letter to a friend about your plans

exercises.instructionEn: When we write a letter to a friend about our plans ...
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI:

  'When we write A LETTER TO A FRIEND ABOUT OUR
   PLANS, we divide the letter into FOUR
   PARAGRAPHS. We START with DEAR + OUR FRIEND'S
   FIRST NAME. In this type of letter we use
   BE GOING TO to talk about our plans/intentions
   and the PRESENT CONTINUOUS to talk about fixed
   future arrangements. To express REASON or
   PURPOSE, we use SO, BECAUSE or TO-INFINITIVE.
   We END the letter with LOVE/BEST WISHES/YOURS,
   + OUR FIRST NAME.'


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Do'stga rejalarimiz haqida xat yozganimizda,
  xatni to'rt xatboshiga bo'lamiz. 'Dear +
  do'stimizning ismi' bilan boshlaymiz. Bunday
  xatda rejalar va niyatlar haqida gapirish uchun
  'be going to' ni, qat'iy belgilangan kelajak
  ishlari haqida gapirish uchun esa 'present
  continuous' ni ishlatamiz. Sabab yoki maqsadni
  ifodalash uchun 'so', 'because' yoki 'to +
  fe'l' dan foydalanamiz. Xatni 'Love / Best
  Wishes / Yours, + ismimiz' bilan tugatamiz.


⚠ KITOBDA KIChIK NOMUVOFIQLIK:
  Quti 'FOUR paragraphs' (to'rt xatboshi) deydi,
  lekin quyidagi 'Plan' BESH xatboshini
  ko'rsatadi (Para 1, 2, 3, 4, 5).
  Amalda PLAN ga amal qiling.


QUTIDAGI TO'RT QOIDA:

  1) BOShLANISh:
     'Dear + do'stning ISMI,'
     Masalan: 'Dear Sarah,'
     DIQQAT: faqat ISM (familiya emas),
     keyin VERGUL.

  2) GRAMMATIKA:
     BE GOING TO       →  rejalar va niyatlar
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS →  qat'iy belgilangan
                           ishlar
     (93-betdagi qoida)

  3) SABAB va MAQSAD:
     SO       →  natija
     BECAUSE  →  sabab
     TO + fe'l →  maqsad
     (95-betdagi qoida)

  4) TUGALLANMA:
     'Love,'         — eng yaqin do'st, qarindosh
     'Best Wishes,'  — do'st, tanish
     'Yours,'        — kamroq yaqin
     keyin ISMINGIZ.


93-BETDAGI JENNINING XATI — ANDOZA:
  Bu qoidalarning hammasi Jennining xatida
  ishlatilgan:
     'Dear Sarah,'                    (boshlanish)
     'we're GOING TO stay ...'        (reja)
     'We're LEAVING on 1st June.'     (belgilangan)
     '... BECAUSE I want to earn ...' (sabab)
     '... TO LOSE some weight.'       (maqsad)
     'Love, Jenny'                    (tugallanma)

points.en: We divide the letter into four paragraphs.
points.noteUz:
⚠ DIQQAT: quti 'four' deydi, lekin quyidagi
Plan BESH xatboshini ko'rsatadi.
Amalda PLAN ga amal qiling.

points.en: We start with Dear + our friend's first name.
points.noteUz:
Faqat ISM (familiya emas).
Keyin VERGUL: 'Dear Sarah,'

points.en: We use be going to to talk about our plans/intentions.
points.uz: Rejalar va niyatlar haqida gapirish uchun 'be going to' ni ishlatamiz.

points.en: We use the present continuous to talk about fixed future arrangements.
points.uz: Qat'iy belgilangan kelajak ishlari haqida gapirish uchun 'present continuous' ni ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
ANIQ VAQT bor (sana, soat).
Jennining xatida: 'We're leaving on 1st June.'

points.en: To express reason or purpose, we use so, because or to-infinitive.
points.uz: Sabab yoki maqsadni ifodalash uchun 'so', 'because' yoki 'to + fe'l' dan foydalanamiz.
points.noteUz:
95-betdagi qoida:
because → sabab, so → natija,
to + fe'l → maqsad.

points.en: We end the letter with Love/Best Wishes/Yours, + our first name.
points.uz: Xatni 'Love / Best Wishes / Yours, + ismimiz' bilan tugatamiz.
points.noteUz:
'Love,' — eng yaqin do'st, qarindosh.
'Best Wishes,' — do'st, tanish.
'Yours,' — kamroq yaqin.
Keyin ISMINGIZ.

exercises.instructionEn: Write a letter to a friend telling him/her about your plans and inviting him/her to your house for a special event. Use the plan below to help you, as well as the letter in Ex. 3.
exercises.instructionUz: Do'stingizga rejalaringiz haqida xat yozing va uni maxsus tadbir uchun uyingizga taklif qiling. Quyidagi rejadan hamda 3-mashqdagi xatdan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI PLAN (daftar shaklida):

  Dear + (your friend's first name,)

  INTRODUCTION
     Para 1:  reason for writing the letter
              (xat yozish sababi)
              ↓
  MAIN BODY
     Para 2, 3:  your plans & intentions with
                 reasons
                 (rejalar va niyatlar, sabablari
                  bilan)
              ↓
     Para 4:  your arrangements — invite him/her
              to your house for a special event
              (belgilangan ishlar — do'stni maxsus
               tadbirga taklif qilish)
              ↓
  CONCLUSION
     Para 5:  closing remarks (eg. See you soon.)
              (yakuniy so'zlar)

  Love,
  (your first name)


HAR XATBOShIDA QAYSI GRAMMATIKA:

  Para 1  →  xat yozish sababi
             (oddiy gaplar, 'I've got some news')
  Para 2,3 →  BE GOING TO + because/so/to-inf
             (rejalar va sabablari)
  Para 4  →  PRESENT CONTINUOUS + aniq sana
             (belgilangan ish) + TAKLIF
  Para 5  →  yakuniy so'zlar


TO'LIQ NAMUNA XAT:

                          12 Bogishamol Street
                          Tashkent
                          10 May, ...

  Dear Aziz,

  How are you? I've got some great news! The
  summer holidays start next week and I've got a
  lot of plans.

  First, I'm going to work at my uncle's shop
  because I want to earn some extra money. I'm
  also going to join a swimming club to get fit.

  In August I'm going to start an English course.
  I want to find a good job next year, so I need
  to speak English well.

  Oh, I nearly forgot! On 20th June we're having a
  big party at our house to celebrate my sister's
  wedding. Would you like to come? You're welcome
  to spend the night here.

  Well, that's all for now. Write soon and tell me
  about your plans. See you soon!

                          Love,
                          Sardor


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

                          Bog'ishamol ko'chasi, 12
                          Toshkent
                          10-may, ...

  Hurmatli Aziz,

  Yaxshimisan? Menda ajoyib yangilik bor! Yozgi
  ta'til keyingi hafta boshlanadi va menda ko'p
  rejalar bor.

  Avvalo, amakimning do'konida ishlamoqchiman,
  chunki bir oz qo'shimcha pul topmoqchiman.
  Shuningdek, chiniqish uchun suzish klubiga a'zo
  bo'lmoqchiman.

  Avgustda ingliz tili kursini boshlamoqchiman.
  Keyingi yil yaxshi ish topmoqchiman, shuning
  uchun ingliz tilida yaxshi gapirishim kerak.

  Voy, sal bo'lmasa unutayozdim! 20-iyunda
  uyimizda opamning to'yini nishonlash uchun katta
  ziyofat qilamiz. Kelishni xohlaysanmi? Kechasi
  shu yerda qolsang ham mayli.

  Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Tezroq yoz va rejalaring
  haqida ayt. Tez orada ko'rishguncha!

                          Mehr bilan,
                          Sardor


GRAMMATIKA — NAMUNADA QAYERDA IShLATILGAN:

  BE GOING TO (rejalar, aniq sana YO'Q):
     'I'm GOING TO work at my uncle's shop'
     'I'm also GOING TO join a swimming club'
     'I'm GOING TO start an English course'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (belgilangan, ANIQ SANA):
     'On 20th June we're HAVING a big party'

  BECAUSE (sabab):
     '... because I want to earn some extra money'

  SO (natija):
     'I want to find a good job next year, SO I
      need to speak English well.'

  TO + fe'l (maqsad):
     '... TO GET fit'
     '... TO CELEBRATE my sister's wedding'

  TAKLIF:
     'WOULD YOU LIKE TO come?'
     (15-mashqdagi muloyim taklif qolipi)


DIQQAT — MANZIL VA SANA:
  Rasmiy bo'lmagan xatda ham manzil va sana
  O'NG YUQORIDA yoziladi (93-betdagi Jennining
  xatidagi kabi).


FOYDALI IBORALAR:
  How are you?               = Yaxshimisan?
  I've got some great news!  = Menda ajoyib
                               yangilik bor!
  First, ... Also, ... Finally, ...
                             = Avvalo ...
                               Shuningdek ...
                               Nihoyat ...
  Oh, I nearly forgot!       = Voy, sal bo'lmasa
                               unutayozdim!
  Would you like to come?    = Kelishni
                               xohlaysanmi?
  You're welcome to ...      = ... bo'lsang mayli
  That's all for now.        = Hozircha shu.
  Write soon.                = Tezroq yoz.
  See you soon!              = Tez orada
                               ko'rishguncha!

structure.heading: SARLAVHA — manzil, sana, murojaat
structure.guideUz:
O'NG YUQORIDA: manzil va sana.
So'ng: 'Dear + do'stning ISMI,'
(faqat ism, keyin VERGUL).
93-betdagi Jennining xatidagi kabi.
structure.modelEn: 12 Bogishamol Street, Tashkent. 10 May, ...  /  Dear Aziz,

structure.heading: Para 1 — INTRODUCTION (xat yozish sababi)
structure.guideUz:
QOLIP:
  'How are you? I've got some great news!
   [nima bo'layotgani] and I've got a lot of
   plans.'

Jennining xati ham shunday boshlangan:
'I've got some great news.'
structure.modelEn: How are you? I've got some great news! The summer holidays start next week and I've got a lot of plans.

structure.heading: Para 2 — REJALAR + SABAB (because)
structure.guideUz:
QOLIP:
  'First, I'm GOING TO [reja] BECAUSE I want to
   [sabab]. I'm also GOING TO [reja] TO [maqsad].'

BE GOING TO — aniq sana YO'Q.
'because' — sabab, 'to + fe'l' — maqsad.
structure.modelEn: First, I'm going to work at my uncle's shop because I want to earn some extra money. I'm also going to join a swimming club to get fit.

structure.heading: Para 3 — REJALAR + NATIJA (so)
structure.guideUz:
QOLIP:
  'In [oy] I'm GOING TO [reja]. I want to
   [maqsad], SO I need to [nima qilish kerak].'

'so' dan OLDIN VERGUL.
DIQQAT: 'so' da tartib 'because' ga nisbatan
TESKARI.
structure.modelEn: In August I'm going to start an English course. I want to find a good job next year, so I need to speak English well.

structure.heading: Para 4 — BELGILANGAN ISH + TAKLIF
structure.guideUz:
QOLIP:
  'Oh, I nearly forgot! On [ANIQ SANA] we're
   [fe'l-ING] a [tadbir] at our house TO CELEBRATE
   [nima]. Would you like to come?'

PRESENT CONTINUOUS — ANIQ SANA bor.
TAKLIF: 'Would you like to ...?' (muloyim).
Jennining xatida ham aynan shu qolip bor edi.
structure.modelEn: Oh, I nearly forgot! On 20th June we're having a big party at our house to celebrate my sister's wedding. Would you like to come? You're welcome to spend the night here.

structure.heading: Para 5 — CONCLUSION + tugallanma
structure.guideUz:
QOLIP:
  'Well, that's all for now. Write soon and tell
   me about your plans. See you soon!'

So'ng: 'Love,' (yoki 'Best Wishes,' / 'Yours,')
va ISMINGIZ.
structure.modelEn: Well, that's all for now. Write soon and tell me about your plans. See you soon!  /  Love, Sardor

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh MAQOL — HAMMASI VAQT va KELAJAK HAQIDA.


1)  TIME WILL TELL.
    = Vaqt ko'rsatadi.

    Bu — UNIT 13 NING NOMI.
    Ma'nosi: kelajakda nima bo'lishini hozir hech
    kim bilmaydi. Faqat VAQT o'tgach ma'lum
    bo'ladi.

    QAChON AYTILADI: kimdir kelajak haqida
    bahslashganda yoki aniq javob bo'lmaganda.
    'Will he be a good president? Time will tell.'

    O'ZBEKChA: 'Vaqt hammasini ko'rsatadi.'


2)  A CHANGE IS AS GOOD AS A REST.
    = O'zgarish dam olishchalik foydali.

    So'zma-so'z: 'O'zgarish dam kabi yaxshi.'

    Ma'nosi: har doim dam olish shart emas —
    ba'zan shunchaki BOShQA ish qilish ham
    kuch beradi.

    Masalan: darsdan charchaganingizda uxlash
    o'rniga sport bilan shug'ullansangiz,
    xuddi dam olgandek tetiklashasiz.

    GRAMMATIKA: 'AS ... AS' qolipi (Unit 12)!
    'as good as' — tenglik.

    O'ZBEKChA: 'Ish almashtirish — dam olish
    bilan barobar.'


3)  TOMORROW NEVER COMES.
    = Ertaga hech qachon kelmaydi.

    Ma'nosi: ishni doim 'ertaga qilaman' deb
    kechiktirsangiz, u hech qachon
    BAJARILMAYDI — chunki har kuni 'bugun'
    bo'ladi, 'ertaga' esa doim oldinda turadi.

    Bu — KEChIKTIRIShGA qarshi ogohlantirish.

    O'ZBEKChA: 'Bugungi ishni ertaga qo'yma.'


UCh MAQOLNING BOG'LIQLIGI:
  1-maqol — kelajak NOMA'LUM
  2-maqol — hozirgi kunni yaxshi o'tkazish
  3-maqol — ishni KEChIKTIRMASLIK

  Uchalasi ham VAQTGA MUNOSABAT haqida.


GRAMMATIK KUZATUV:
  1-maqolda 'WILL' — Unit 13 ning grammatikasi.
  2-maqolda 'AS ... AS' — Unit 12 ning
     grammatikasi.
  3-maqolda 'NEVER' + PRESENT SIMPLE —
     umumiy haqiqat.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a change = o'zgarish
  a rest   = dam olish
  never    = hech qachon

sentences.noteUz:
UNIT 13 NING NOMI.
Kelajakda nima bo'lishini hozir hech kim
bilmaydi — faqat vaqt ko'rsatadi.
GRAMMATIKA: 'WILL' — unitning grammatikasi.
O'zbekcha: 'Vaqt hammasini ko'rsatadi.'

sentences.en: A change is as good as a rest.
sentences.noteUz:
Har doim dam olish shart emas — ba'zan
BOSHQA ish qilish ham kuch beradi.
GRAMMATIKA: 'AS ... AS' qolipi (Unit 12)!
O'zbekcha: 'Ish almashtirish — dam olish bilan
barobar.'

Ishni doim 'ertaga qilaman' deb kechiktirsangiz,
u hech qachon bajarilmaydi — chunki har kuni
'bugun' bo'ladi.
KEChIKTIRIShGA qarshi ogohlantirish.
O'zbekcha: 'Bugungi ishni ertaga qo'yma.'

wordFormation.introUz: 97-bet — kelajak bashoratlari, taklif iboralari va /h/ talaffuzi.

items.derived: People will travel in flying cars.
There will be more people in the world.

groups.ruleUz: TAKLIF QILISh, QABUL QILISh va RAD ETISh (15-mashq)

items.base: Do you want to come with me?
Would you like to come with me?
I'd love to, but I can't. [SABAB]

patterns.formula: THERE WILL BE + OT.   /   THERE WON'T BE ENOUGH + OT.
patterns.exampleEn: There will be more people in the world. There won't be enough trees.
patterns.exampleUz: Dunyoda odamlar ko'proq bo'ladi. Yetarlicha daraxt bo'lmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
OT bilan 'THERE will be'.
'enough' OT dan OLDIN turadi.
'won't' = 'will not'.

patterns.formula: Do you want to / WOULD YOU LIKE TO come with me?  —  I'd love to.
patterns.exampleEn: Would you like to come with me? — I'd love to.
patterns.explanationUz:
TAKLIF QILISH va QABUL QILISH.
'Would you like to' — muloyimroq.
'I'd love to' — 'to' dan keyin fe'l
takrorlanmaydi.

patterns.formula: I'd love to, BUT I CAN'T. [SABAB].
patterns.exampleEn: I'd love to, but I can't. I'm going to the cinema with Bob.
patterns.exampleUz: Juda xohlardim, lekin bora olmayman. Bob bilan kinoga boryapman.
patterns.explanationUz:
MULOYIM RAD ETISH — uch qism:
xohlash + imkonsizlik + SABAB.
Faqat 'No' deyish QO'POL hisoblanadi.

patterns.formula: On [ANIQ SANA] we're [fe'l-ING] ... TO CELEBRATE ... . Would you like to come?
patterns.exampleEn: On 20th June we're having a big party at our house to celebrate my sister's wedding. Would you like to come?
patterns.exampleUz: 20-iyunda uyimizda opamning to'yini nishonlash uchun katta ziyofat qilamiz. Kelishni xohlaysanmi?
patterns.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS + ANIQ SANA (belgilangan ish)
+ 'to celebrate' (maqsad) + TAKLIF.
Xatning 4-xatboshisi uchun qolip.

patterns.formula: an hour / an honest man   ↔   a hand / a horrible week
patterns.exampleEn: It will take an hour. He is an honest man. Give me a hand.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu bir soat oladi. U halol odam. Menga yordam ber.
patterns.explanationUz:
Artikl HARFGA emas, TOVUSHGA qaraydi.
'h' o'qilmasa → AN, o'qilsa → A.
